title: [meal-audit] scout detected Green Grapes as a dish; logged meal keeps 1 item and drops its box

defect.observed: Scout emitted 2 dishes for job_1790784359089_kvt6r0c0g (Sainsbury Oat and Fruit bbox [250,100,955,990]; Green Grapes bbox [390,110,875,880]) but pendingFoodLog.itemsBreakdown has 1 entry carrying the first bbox verbatim, so Green Grapes has no independent ledger entry, weight, or box.
defect.expected: Every scout dish is represented as its own itemsBreakdown entry with its own bbox, the way the Prawn-and-Ham meal keeps two scout dishes as two ledger entries with distinct boxes.
defect.criteria: curl -s https://pub-2ae421ce82904986ae87c8bc27552cff.r2.dev/debug/Pqc9RG33GRdELpXvkqI4EJhHyQ53/job_1790784359089_kvt6r0c0g.json | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{const j=JSON.parse(s);const sc=(j.result.rawScout.dishes||[]);const it=(j.result.pendingFoodLog.itemsBreakdown||[]);const miss=sc.filter(sd=>!it.some(x=>JSON.stringify(x.boundingBox2D)===JSON.stringify(sd.boundingBox2D)));console.log('dropped:'+JSON.stringify(miss.map(m=>m.dishName)));process.exit(miss.length?1:0);});" exits 0 with no dropped dishes
